title: EXPON.DIST: 4,000 of 4,000 held out - and a second, conflicting figure in OxFunc
status_plain: EXPON.DIST's body is the same legacy x87 per-operation double-rounded class as WEIBULL.DIST's, and the b28c gate -- 4,000 fresh rows against production -- matched every one. A hundred percent on a held-out gate is the strongest result in this slice, and OxFunc contradicts it elsewhere: a later PMT-lane note records EXPON.DIST at 99.96% on SSE2, and the shared expm1 primitive that serves the EXPON.DIST cdf scores 17,996 of 18,000. Both are published here beside the 4,000; the hundred percent may not stand alone.

counts.build_note: Not restated near the figure. The only build statement in the W109 identification note is scoped to one battery -- "## The multi-view collapse (battery B1, 829 probes, build 20131)" at line 15 -- and the catalogue's build sentence describes the 48-case 2026-07-10 recon corpus, not these batteries. Not inherited.
counts.ambiguity_note: A later OxFunc document gives 99.96% for this surface. The two figures are both live in the tree and the sources contradict each other; this one may not render alone.
counts.source_sentence: **EXPON.DIST (b28b + b28c):** body is the same legacy x87 per-op-DR class: inner `lambda*x` 14/14 DR, pdf outer `lambda*e` 24/24 DR, twins 40/40. Landed (`excel_x87_mul` at both sites). **b28c held-out (fresh 4,000 rows, production): 4,000/4,000 = 100.000%.**

counts.build_note: The PMT resume names no Excel build for this aside.
counts.ambiguity_note: A percentage in a passing aside, five days after the 100.000% gate, with no corpus named. It contradicts the b28c figure and the sources do not reconcile. Published as the weaker reading alongside, not instead.
counts.source_sentence: Optional +2 micro-landing available (spill-Kahan em) but marginal (po2n +0.4%) and touches the shared excel_expm1_internal (serves EXPON.DIST at 99.96% SSE2) -- hold unless made PMT-local.

counts.build_note: The primitive table names no build.
counts.ambiguity_note: This scores the shared `excel_expm1_internal` PRIMITIVE that serves the EXPON.DIST and WEIBULL.DIST cdfs, not either surface. Recorded because a surface cannot be cleaner than the primitive it depends on, and this one is not 100%.
counts.source_sentence: | Internal expm1 | Kahan correction in DOUBLE ... | excel_expm1_internal; EXPON/WEIBULL cdf + a==1 wrapper | 17,996/18,000 (99.978%) |

evidence_locality_note: Every W109 battery (b14, b19, b20, b21, b22, b26, b30, b31) lives under `smart-fuzzer/work/` or `smart-fuzzer/cache/`, both gitignored in OxFunc.
substrate: the same legacy x87 per-operation double-rounded body class as WEIBULL.DIST: lambda*x and the pdf's lambda*e are both double-rounded, landed as `excel_x87_mul` at both sites
ruled_out: plain SSE2 at either multiplication site
open_question: OxFunc publishes two irreconcilable figures for this surface, 100.000% and 99.96%, and does not say which supersedes the other.
reader_warning: 100.000% held out is real and it is not the whole picture: a second OxFunc document gives 99.96% for the same surface, and the shared expm1 primitive underneath it is measured at 17,996 of 18,000. Any claim that this surface is numerically clean has to survive all three numbers.
